profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Whisker Labs

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical lead on .Net focused development team.  Our team is responsible for maintenance of over 80 applications processing 80 million messages a day.  

- Responsible for technical direction within the team
- Work closely with Project Management and the rest of the agile team to define features and their implementations with careful attention to quality, scalability, and maintainability.
